pr_body:
This PR adds system data streams to the "snapshot feature state" code block, so that if we're snapshotting a feature by name we grab that feature's system data streams too.

Fixes #75860
pr_title: Add system data streams to feature state snapshots

review_comment: Added a comment to the linked issue so we remember to clean up the places we have to work around this in tests. No action required here, just noting.
Just re-reading this PR I noticed: Are we guaranteed to have the feature `name` available? If we don't have the right plugins active at restore time we'll just NPE here won't we?
That's a great catch. Thank you!
